messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman stands in profile, initially with her arms crossed, then uncrosses them and begins to walk slowly forward and to the left.","camera":"The camera starts with a full-body shot and gradually zooms in to a medium close-up of her upper body and face as she moves.","clothing":"She wears a loose, bright pink short-sleeved top over a matching pink mini-skirt, paired with pink flat shoes.","hair_color":"Her hair is a reddish-brown or auburn color.","hairstyle":"Her hair is styled in a low ponytail with straight bangs across her forehead.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young woman with a slim build, fair skin, and a youthful face.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor cobblestone street in front of a dark, ornate building facade with large windows and red curtains."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output begins in a side profile full-body view matching the reference, then gradually moves closer to an upper-body framing. The woman's pose and movement are broadly similar, but the scene background is replaced with a different dark storefront facade, and her clothing appears as a pink top and skirt rather than the source's pink top with dark shorts.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a side-view dolly-in from full-body to upper-body framing, using the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, clothing, action, timing, and scene.
uncertain: Whether the action timing and progression exactly match the source video
unexpected_changes: Scene changed from the source's open brick street with Union Jack flag to a different dark storefront facade
Clothing changed from pink top with dark shorts to a pink top and matching pink skirt
Footwear changed from white/red sneakers to pink flat shoes
Initial pose changed from walking away to standing in profile with arms crossed
